notes: Sets of encoded bit strings under the declared token encoding; companions of the registered SAT and TAUT languages; malformed strings belong to neither.

role: input bit length and number of distinct variables of an instance
notes: Size measures of the truth-table bound; k is at most m/12.

role: valuation table and the valuation it determines
notes: A finite list of numeral and truth-value pairs; the valuation is false off the table.
Repeatedly replaces a negation marker followed by a truth value by the opposite value; metalinguistic bookkeeping of the evaluator.

role: premise set of the variables indexed by A
notes: For A a subset of the natural numbers, the set of p_n with n in A.
Doubled bits of x, then 01, then y; injective and decoded in one scan.

role: complement of a language in the set of bit strings
notes: The set of bit strings not in L; chosen instead of an overline because the overline is the registered literal complement.
Maps a formula encoding to the encoding of its negation and malformed strings to the encoding of negated falsum.

role: computation formula of a verifier on input x
notes: Satisfiable exactly when x is in the NP language.

role: state head and cell variables of the computation formula
notes: Propositional variables with distinct mixed-radix indices; local to the proof.
Disjunction of the arguments conjoined with all pairwise negated conjunctions.

role: displayed most general unifiers of the annotated refutation
notes: Term substitutions in the sense of the first-order resolution section; theta_3 is the identity.
The truth value other than b; local to the evaluator proof.
